issue.title: Hide launch proof tools and polish support UI
issue.body:
## Summary
- Hide launch proof/smoke UI from normal builds and keep internal support tools compile-gated
- Keep the Settings suggestion box on the Formspree support endpoint and auto-dismiss feedback banners
- Remove visible proof wording from the AI edit quick prompts

## Verification
- XcodeBuildMCP `build_sim` for `HoopsClips` succeeded with `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`
- `bash ios/scripts/verify_internal_staging_config.sh`
- `plutil -lint ios/exportOptions.testflight-internal.plist`
- `git diff --check`
- no-secret diff scan
- visible proof/smoke/testing wording scan

## Notes
- No upload/detection/edit/render architecture changes
- No archive/TestFlight upload attempted; Apple Developer license/provisioning is still the external gate
